title: Web
description: Open web search results or an http or https page on the phone for the user to look at. These actions return only a browser handoff, never search results or page content. To answer a question or look something up, use eva.web.research instead.

tool.name: search
tool.title: Search the web
tool.description: Open a web search in the phone's browser or search app when the user wants to see the results themselves. Returns only a handoff, never search results or page content. To answer a question or look something up, use eva.web.research instead.

receipts.handlerMissing: No browser or search app is available.

tool.name: open
tool.title: Open a web page
tool.description: Open an http or https page in the phone's browser when the user wants to see it themselves. Returns only a handoff, never page content; opening is not reading. To answer a question or read a public page, use eva.web.research instead.

url.description: A complete http or https address
